name: The Braai Budget Challenge
shortDescription: Sipho, Thembi and Themba race to buy the missing ingredients for Gogo Maria’s birthday braai while using prices, quantities, addition, subtraction and fair sharing to stay within budget.
longDescription: Gogo Maria’s birthday braai is almost ready, but Sipho, Thembi and Themba still need to buy the missing ingredients. Armed with a shopping list and a limited budget, the children compare prices and sizes, count quantities, add their grocery total, calculate their change and make careful choices before heading home. Along the way, they discover how practical mathematics can help a family shop wisely, check what they need and share what remains fairly.
